# scaling_working_hours (Data Source)

Looks up a working-hours set by name and exposes its id, so an escalation step condition can reference a set created out-of-band without hardcoding the generated id.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Reference a working-hours set created out-of-band by name, for use in an
# escalation step condition's working_hours_id.
data "scaling_working_hours" "business" {
  name = "Business Hours"
}

output "business_hours_id" {
  value = data.scaling_working_hours.business.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the working-hours set to look up. Must be unique within the organization.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) ISO 8601 creation timestamp.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the matched working-hours set.
- `org_id` (String) Organization that owns the working-hours set.
- `timezone` (String) IANA timezone the windows are evaluated in.
- `updated_at` (String) ISO 8601 last-update timestamp.
